name: Anki
category: desktop/mobile app (spaced-repetition flashcards; Rust core shared by desktop, AnkiDroid backend and sync server)
param_style: rusqlite: ? / ?N positional and :name named; .sql files pulled in with include_str! and extended with concat!/format!; browser searches built by rslib/src/search/sqlwriter.rs
schema_source: rslib/src/storage/schema11.sql + rslib/src/storage/upgrades/schema14/15/17/18_upgrade.sql (CREATE statements only; unicase collation -> NOCASE; temp tables as plain tables)
data_scale: scale 1: 42 decks (5-level-deep tree + 1 filtered), 4 notetypes, 20k notes, ~35k cards (30% new, 50% review, learning/suspended/buried mix), 120k revlog rows over 2 years, 600 graves
visibility_note: 32k stars; the Rust core (rslib) is the storage layer of Anki desktop and the official sync server, and AnkiDroid uses the same backend
interest_note: Scheduler queue building over the (did, queue, due) index with the active_decks temp table, deck-list due counts as boolean-sum aggregates, browser searches compiled to SQL (LIKE with ESCAPE, REGEXP, correlated introduced/rated revlog subqueries, correlated sort_order sort keys), window-function sort setup.
reach_note: millions of users; the same Rust backend (rslib) also powers AnkiDroid and AnkiMobile
